description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token plus at least one additional artifact token due to Stridehangar Automaton
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite tapped artifact tokens, you may activate Krark-Clan Ironworks any number of times by sacrificing any number of them, adding infinite colorless mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped artifact creature tokens.
Once you have infinite untapped artifacts, you may activate Clock of Omens any number of times to untap any number of artifacts infinite times.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Thopter, creating a 4/4 Construct and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Construct and Thopter, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Repeat.
